model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of different language families on the performance of three language models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, and XLM-R2. The horizontal axis represents language families, ordered as IE-Indic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Three sets of bars are presented for each language family, corresponding to the models mBERT-L2 (green), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-B2 (red), and XLM-R2 (teal). Error bars extend above and below each bar, representing the variability in the effect values. The shortest bars, associated with the Uralic language family and the mBERT-L2 model, have an approximate value of 1, while the tallest bars, associated with the IE-Germanic language family and the XLM-L2 model, reach approximately 27. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the initial ordering of language families, and no bars are visually emphasized.
